trailhead.label: North shore of the small Montiggl lake, where path 1/A arrives from Parkplatz Montiggl (1.2 km); the car park beside it is private

cautions: About 0.6 km on asphalt access roads with lido and hotel traffic.
Short stretch on the Montiggler Straße.
Roots and stones, slippery when wet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.North shore of the small Montiggl lake,: Sponda nord del lago piccolo di Montiggl, dove arriva il sentiero 1/A dal Parkplatz Montiggl (1,2 km); il parcheggio accanto è privato
textIt.About 0.6 km on asphalt access roads wit: Circa 0,6 km su strade d'accesso asfaltate con il traffico del lido e degli hotel.
Radici e sassi, scivolosi quando sono bagnati.
